children.description: The content of the dialog. This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the payload of the active trigger.

defaultTriggerId.description:
ID of the trigger that the dialog is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open dialog.

type.name: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement)

handle.description:
A handle to associate the dialog with a trigger.
If specified, allows external triggers to control the dialog's open state.
Can be created with the Dialog.createHandle() method.

onOpenChange.description: Event handler called when the dialog is opened or closed.

onOpenChangeComplete.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the dialog is opened or closed.

onRequestClose.description:
Called when the user asks to close (escape, backdrop, dismiss button).
Receives BaseUI's change-event details (reason + originating event),
matching how BaseUI types its open/close callbacks.

open.description: Whether the dialog is currently open.

size.description:
Width of the dialog.
On mobile when this is set to "fullScreen" the bottom sheet will be full screen (100% height).

triggerId.description:
ID of the trigger that the dialog is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled dialog.
There's no need to specify this prop when the dialog is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

type.description:
Type of the dialog. An `alertdialog` requires the user to choose an action
before it can be closed (no outside/backdrop dismissal).

align.description: Layout for the right-hand action group.

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

children.description: Body content; describes the dialog (wired to `aria-describedby`).

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.

children.description:
Optional content for the dismiss control. An Atlantis `<Button>` is adapted
automatically; any other valid element is used as-is. Defaults to a subtle
tertiary `Button` with a `cross` icon when neither `children` nor `render`
is provided.

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

nativeButton.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

render.description:
Renders a custom dismiss element in place of the default close button.
Pass an element or a function that receives the
BaseUI close props (so the element stays wired to close the dialog).

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.

children.description:
Footer content. Commonly a `Dialog.Actions`, but the footer is a generic
region — it can hold anything (a note, a checkbox, a custom layout).

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.

children.description:
Header content — commonly a `Dialog.Title` and a `Dialog.Close`. The header
only owns layout; it does not impose typography or actions.

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.

children.description:
Content that scrolls together — typically a `Dialog.Body` and a non-pinned
`Dialog.Header`/`Dialog.Footer`.

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.

children.description:
Title text. Rendered as a `Heading` and auto-wired to the dialog's
`aria-labelledby`.

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.

children.description:
Trigger content; an Atlantis `<Button>` or raw text.
Optional content forwarded to the rendered element.

className.description: Class name applied to the part's root element.

handle.description:
Links a detached trigger to a `Dialog` with the matching `handle`, when the
trigger can't be nested inside the `Dialog`.

id.description:
ID of the trigger. In addition to being forwarded to the rendered element,
it is also used to specify the active trigger for the dialog in controlled mode (with the DialogRoot `triggerId` prop).

nativeButton.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

payload.description: Data passed to the dialog when this trigger opens it (used with `handle`).

render.description: Renders a custom trigger element in place of the default `<Button>`.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the part's root element.
